title: 第1章 永恒领域！-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    耳畔响起沙沙的电磁音，许默渐渐恢复意识，整个身体就像是浸泡在湖水中，阴冷潮湿，闷得他几乎喘不过气。

    “好冷~”

    “怎么回事？”

    许默睁开眼，荒原上弥漫着白雾，婆娑的树影显得无比怪诞，任凭湿冷的寒风穿过，然后发出呢喃般诡异的尖啸……

    他不是躺在家里吗？

    这是哪？

    【欢迎来到永恒领域！】

    【恭喜诸位，作为蓝星的幸运儿，将有机会见证永恒！】

    【作为新手福利，请牢记这句话：永远不要试图改变永恒领域的世界规则！你们的目标只有一个：活着！】

    电磁音消失的很是突兀，周围安静的又只剩下了风声。

    许默脸色紧绷，脑海中还在不断重复着刚刚那句提示的时候，一道信息界面毫无预兆的映入眼帘。

    【属性】【频道】【交易】【制作】

    许默闭上眼睛，压住内心的恐惧，片刻后，他深吸一口气，开始研究眼前的界面，首先是【频道】-【局域频道】。

    心念微动后，一个新的界面就弹了出来。

    【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：7023】

    【编号56742681：老天……谁知道现在是什么情况？有没有能解释一下的？】

    【编号36485268：到处都是森林，看着好吓人，我想回家。】

    【编号24621584：这是生存游戏？光说别改变规则，特么什么规则倒是说清楚啊！】

    ……

    局域频道内，此刻已经炸了锅，人们惊慌且疑惑，许默眉头紧皱的翻看着，大多数人的第一反应都跟他差不多。

    就在他也准备发送消息的时候，一道提示忽然弹出。

    【发送局域频道内容，需要消耗理智值：1点理智值/次】

    保险起见，许默没有轻举妄动，转而点开了【属性】。

    【幸存者编号：66448231】

    【生存能力：6】

    【生命：150/150】

    【饱腹：123/150】

    【干渴：138/150】

    【理智：148/150】

    【体力：149/150】

    【负重：0/15】

    【天赋-酿酒师：你无需任何食谱，即可尝试酿造各种酒水，饮用后获得不同效果。】

    【装备：暂无】
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There was a rustling electromagnetic sound in his ears, and Xu Mo gradually regained consciousness. His whole body felt like it was soaked in lake water, cold and damp, so stuffy that he could hardly breathe.

“It’s so cold~”

"What's going on?"

Xu Mo opened his eyes, and saw that the wilderness was filled with white mist, and the shadows of the dancing trees looked extremely weird. The cold and wet wind passed through, and then emitted a strange scream like a whisper...

Isn’t he lying at home?

Where is this?

【Welcome to the eternal realm!】

【Congratulations to all of you, as the lucky ones of Blue Star, you will have the opportunity to witness eternity!】

【As a novice benefit, please remember this sentence: Never try to change the world rules of the eternal realm!You have only one goal: stay alive!】

The electromagnetic sound disappeared suddenly, and only the sound of wind was left in the quiet surroundings.

Xu Mo’s face was tense, and while he was still repeating the reminder in his mind, an information interface came into view without warning.

【Attribute】【Channel】【Transaction】【Production】

Xu Mo closed his eyes and suppressed the fear in his heart. After a moment, he took a deep breath and began to study the interface in front of him, first of all, [Channel] - [Local Channel].

After thinking slightly, a new interface popped up.

【Current area number: 9527 Number of survivors: 7023】

【No. 56742681: God...Who knows what the situation is now?Can anyone explain it?】

【No. 36485268: There are forests everywhere. It looks so scary. I want to go home.】

【No. 24621584: Is this a survival game?Just say don’t change the rules, what kind of rules should you make clear!】

……

The local channel was in a state of panic. People were panicked and confused. Xu Mo looked through the pages with a frown on his face. Most people's first reaction was similar to his.

Just when he was about to send the message, a prompt suddenly popped up.

[Sending local channel content requires sanity points: 1 sanity point/time]

To be on the safe side, Xu Mo did not act rashly and instead clicked on [Attributes].

【Survivor number: 66448231】

【Survivability: 6】

【Life: 150/150】

【Full stomach: 123/150】

【Thirst: 138/150】

【Sanity: 148/150】

【Stamina: 149/150】

【Weight load: 0/15】

【Talent-Brewmaker: You can try brewing various drinks without any recipes, and get different effects after drinking them.】

【Equipment: None】
Page (1/3)
